title: Jesus... My Whole Future Is Behind One Result Page
topic: waiting for tomorrow's result that decides his future

bible.text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... the result comes out tomorrow at ten. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: One login. One page. It decides where I live, what I earn, who I become.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You refreshed the university site four times today knowing it wasn't updated yet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I can't help it. Two years of my life are hiding behind that one button.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The nights you studied when nobody clapped already happened. A webpage cannot un-happen them.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if the number isn't enough? What do I tell my parents?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You tell them the truth, and I'll be standing beside you when the page loads either way.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I keep imagining both futures and my chest gets tight in both.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put both futures down tonight. I'm already in whichever one opens, and I don't love you differently in either.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Sleep tonight. The page will still be there in the morning, and so will I.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What result are you waiting on? 🙏
